note: Read 2026-11-01 at the owner's word ("Build those first 3 starting with ledger first"; of the 21 countries read first: "It should cover across every country"; "Retry the blocked tax facts once all countries land"): the tax on a screen worker's pay in Maldives: a resident's income tax, social contributions, what is withheld at source, a non-resident artiste's withholding, an author's treatment, VAT and the tax year. Research and retry subagents (workbench/briefs/BRIEF-tax.md, BRIEF-tax-retry.md), every quote checked by the lead against its saved page.

figures.finding: Under the Maldives Retirement Pension Scheme the employer and the employee each pay 7% of the employee's basic salary every month (14% in all).

sources.said: ވަޒީފާދޭ ފަރާތުންނާއި ވަޒީފާއަދާކުރާ ފަރާތުން ޕެންޝަން ކޮންޓްރިބިއުޝަންގެ ގޮތުގައި ކޮންމެ މަހަކު ސްކީމަށް ދައްކަނީ މުވައްޒަފުގެ އަސާސީ މުސާރައިގެ %7 (ދެ ފަރާތުން ޖުމްލަ %14) އެވެ
